ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white ventral surface vs 15% low-intensity black peripheral and focal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous thick black banding along the upper distal margins. Symmetrical black mottling concentrated at the base of the median notch. Dispersed circular black spots located in the mid-to-upper regions of both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe distal area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped indentation with an estimated 40-50 degree internal angle; depth occupies approximately 12% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary; right lobe exhibits larger, more distinct jagged peaks (5-15 pixel amplitude) than the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep on the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of raised, circular calcified organisms (barnacles) along the full length of the trailing edge and outer tips. Two distinct tan circular marks visible on the lower-left interior lobe quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four near-vertical black linear streaks on the mid-right lobe; one prominent diagonal black line extending from the lower-right margin toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization. Multiple dark circular pigmentation marks and linear rake-like streaks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of distinct circular ring markings (dark outlines with high-intensity centers) localized in the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe.
